item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 24, 2026
item.description: We have a surprising capacity for emotional depth. As Luna trines transformative Pluto at 4:55 am EST, we can turn relaxed chats into fertile ground for future breakthroughs. This can't be forced, though, so we ought to start gently and pay attention to the way feelings naturally shift as the day rolls on. While the Moon's square to the Sun stirs tension between comfort and clarity, staying curious keeps hearts open. We can move slowly and still make progress by being honest with ourselves.
